content.title: Vegetable Garden Project Plan
content.body:
# Vegetable Garden Project Plan

A comprehensive plan for starting a small vegetable garden in the backyard, tailored for beginners with a focus on zone 7b climate.

## Garden Layout

Planning a beginner-friendly garden bed of 4ft x 8ft, in a location receiving about 6 hours of sunlight daily. Need to confirm if 6 hours of sunlight is sufficient for most vegetables. Research needed on ideal dimensions for beginner raised bed gardens.

## Supplies Needed

- Soil
- Containers or raised bed materials
- Seeds
- Basic gardening tools
- Watering system (considering simple drip irrigation)
- Potential fencing for pest control (rabbits spotted in neighborhood)

Exploring natural pest deterrents as an alternative to chemicals.

## Planting Schedule

Aim to have everything planted by early May. Specific planting times for each vegetable are detailed in the [[Planting Calendar for Vegetable Garden]]. Interest in companion planting, such as basil near tomatoes, to be explored.
